description: This bar chart, titled "Runtime Comparison of Models in Streaming Environment," illustrates the runtime in seconds for different models, with the vertical axis labeled "Runtime (seconds)" ranging from 0 to 400 in increments of 50, and the horizontal axis listing five categories: "Our Joint Framework," "ChatGPT," "DeepSeek," "LLaMA," and "Claude." A legend in the top-left corner indicates that green bars represent "Our Joint Framework" and blue bars represent "LLM Models." The chart displays a single green bar for "Our Joint Framework" with a value of 77 seconds. For the four LLM models, each has a corresponding blue bar with its runtime value labeled on top: "ChatGPT" has a runtime of 190 seconds, "DeepSeek" has 365 seconds, "LLaMA" has 172 seconds, and "Claude" has 243 seconds. The bars are arranged in the order listed on the horizontal axis, and no bars are visually emphasized or sorted in any particular order beyond their positional arrangement.
